summary.en: The Immigration notification about a spouse is separate from whether you can keep your current status. If your status is based on being a spouse, the divorce may change the basis of your status. Check the official Immigration guidance about your future stay and consult Immigration (to be checked). To change to another status, you apply for a change of status of residence.

lead.en: Apart from the notification, consult Immigration about your future stay.
